# Saved Mesh-domain fixtures

These files are generated by this repository's
[generate_mesh.py](../generate_mesh.py), using the shared Scene-oracle
helpers in [generate_scene.py](../generate_scene.py). They are original,
redistributable test data under the repository's [license](../../../LICENSE).
Blender runs only as a separate generation and verification process.

## Provenance

Generated and reopened on Windows on 2026-10-04:

| File | Blender build | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blender-4.5.13/mesh.blend` | 4.5.13 LTS, `daeeeca98fb0` | 390353 | `e5b3447250a58bc6eda93ee33479c055d4c4fc794e6bd428fffc3496e1af42a3` |
| `blender-5.2.2/mesh.blend` | 5.2.2 LTS, `d13f752e3b9c` | 507882 | `f709bc270bac5c6b41ffc7e763a41b3f8d722dc9b1804526ff3e3fccfd9fb297` |

Both are uncompressed normal-save files with one active Scene, `MeshDomains`,
source unit scale `0.01`, five Mesh Objects and four unique Mesh datablocks.
There are no modifiers, shape keys, animation or linked libraries. File-browser
directories use `//`; generator tests reject absolute Windows/home paths.

## Cases

| Mesh | Points / faces / corners / UV maps | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Empty` | 0 / 0 / 0 / 1 | named render UV on an empty Mesh |
| `Loose` | 3 / 0 / 0 / 1 | retained loose points and an empty UV domain; one source loose edge is not published by the polygon IR |
| `NoUv` | 3 / 1 / 3 / 0 | polygon without a UV map |
| `Seams` | 5 / 2 / 7 / 2 | quad/triangle corner seams, repeated coordinates, signed zeros, negative and greater-than-one coordinates |

`Seams` and `SharedSeams` use the same Mesh with different Object transforms.
The editing map is `Seams`; the non-first render map is `Constant`.
`Seams` has five unique numeric pairs with exact indices
`[0, 1, 2, 0, 3, 4, 1]`. The first `(0, -0)` and later `(-0, 0)` share an
index while retaining the first stored representation. All `Constant`
corners use `(-0.25, 1.5)` and therefore publish one indexed value.
Constant coordinates do not imply constant serialized storage.

## Oracle and checks

Each adjacent ASCII `.oracle.txt` uses `BLEND_SCENE_ORACLE 1`: source unit
scale, Object membership/data/world/local values, then Mesh points, polygon
counts, corner indices, corner normals and named per-corner UV values.
It is captured after saving and checked again after reopening the saved file.
UV values compare exactly, including zero signs; matrices, points and normals
use `math.isclose(rel_tol=2e-6, abs_tol=2e-6)` during generator checks.

`blendScene.meshFixture` reuses the Scene-oracle executable in both root and
standalone builds, without Blender or OpenUSD. It compares owning meter/basis
converted points and transforms, unchanged topology, normalized corner normals,
exact first-occurrence UV values/indices and the render selector. Native
matrix/point tolerance is `2e-5 * (1 + abs(expected))`; normal-component
tolerance is `2e-5`. Empty Meshes emit exactly one contextual recoverable
`BLEND_MESH_EMPTY` warning each. Repeated and reversed-block reads retain
all IR values exactly after the borrowed reader inputs have been released.

Registered-plugin stage tests compare the same oracles, including empty and
loose-point extents, indexed face-varying UV shapes, metadata-only hierarchy,
repeat reads and reference composition.

The Blender 5.2 file also reproduces zero-size dense `AttributeArray` storage
with nonzero data keys but no corresponding serialized DATA blocks. Such
keys are unused: no elements exist to read. Only dense zero-domain arrays
skip data-key resolution; their logical size, storage shape and single flag
remain validated. Constants on empty domains still require one stored value,
and nonempty arrays retain exact-key resolution and exact payload lengths.
Four synthetic pointer-width/byte-order layouts pin these distinctions.
The 4.5 control uses CustomData and retains its existing validation.

The generator's `--check` regenerates only into temporary storage, then
inspects the committed file without rewriting it or its oracle.
[test_generate_mesh.py](../test_generate_mesh.py) verifies cross-process/path
semantic reproduction, non-destructive success/failure, modified-oracle
rejection and saved UV-coordinate/zero-sign/render-map/loose-point/sharing
mutations. Full-file addresses and UI state are not byte-reproducible.
Commands are in the [build guide](../../../docs/guides/building.md#saved-mesh-domain-oracles).

These fixtures do not establish legacy fixed-array Mesh storage, Blender-written
MLoopUV, loose-edge authoring or additional Blender version families.
